title: Green languages and growth of free inverse monoids
summary: Motivated by recent work on conjugacy languages in groups, we introduce a general framework for studying \emph{languages of representatives} associated to equivalence relations on finitely generated semigroups. After developing this notion in full generality, we particularize it to Green's relations and obtain the corresponding Green languages, which form the central objects of this article.
